title: Trivia Ticklers - The Phone Trivia Game
summary: A Phone Trivia Game in React that exports to a scoreboard
content:
Trivia Ticklers is one of my latest projects. You might be thinking, “Oh cool, a mobile app that lets me play trivia with my friends!” Wrong.
Trivia Ticklers is imports a database of trivia and players and generates weekly matchups with a set of questions and lets you keep track of score. It is purpose built for a very specific type of trivia I play with some friends and family. Only the trivia master needs to use the app and everyone else just needs to answer their phone.
All the data is stored locally, so don’t go rogue and clear your cache, or at least export a backup of the data first.
The game exports a scoreboard JSON file which is used in the scoreboard site.
There is much refactoring to be done, but this years trivia has already started so it will be at least 6 more weeks before any more work is done on the app.
I think the dream version of it would have a phone tree system where after a player is asked their questions, they would call the next person or group of people. Because as it is, the trivia master is a lot of work.

title: GaijinSensei.com Released
summary: GaijinSensei.com - An Online Collection of ESOL Lessons
content:
I have released my website GaijinSensei.com, a online resource full of English teaching and learning materials. It’s still a work in progress and the framework it is built on, Zensical, is still in alpha.
Feel free to check it out as I slowly but surely add and reorganize the content posted there.

title: Dinosauroscopes
summary: Find out what dinosaur you are, and get your daily dinosauroscope
content:
I recently made a site that generates a daily Dinosauroscopes using Puter.js. It makes a query once a day (for that visitor) and retrieves a dinosaur based horoscope. In order to get your daily dinosauroscope you need to accept the pop-up message from Puter.
If you don’t want to give it permission to run the query or hate the use of AI, feel free to click cancel and enjoy the Quiz and “Dive into a Dino” features.
https://mattkissel.github.io/dinosauroscopes/

title: Riceball Couple 1
summary: A short story about a riceball couple to practice the use of frequency words
content:
My boyfriend and I sometimes watch movies.
We often cuddle.

I rarely snore.
My boyfriend never yells.
I am almost always quiet
He frequently supports women’s rights.

We often make out

content:

title: A Lost Ring
summary: A real-life and online treasure hunt for a ring of power
content:
A while back as a birthday present for my sister, I made a real life treasure hunt. The theme of this hunt was for a ring of power from Lord of the Rings.
To test out the hunt I built a web version of the hunt using Ink and Inky. It’s quite similar to, and was inspired by, my other treasure hunt, Champlain’s Treasure.
You can find the digital version of A Lost Ring here.

title: Champlains Treasure
summary: A real-life and online hunt for the treasure of Samuel de Champlain
content:
A while back I made a treasure hunt for a friend to solve. This involved hiding random clues around their house and leading them from one clue to another. While I was making the hunt, I found myself wanting to test it out without remaking physical clues all the time.
I decided to use Ink and Inky to help me create a digital version of the hunt - a proof of concept. With Ink I was able to test for coherency and see if it would be fun. The difficulty was another story because it’s easy to solve the hunt when dealing with multiple choice.
You can find the digital version here.
